problem: unittest discovery collects TestCase classes only, so a module-level test function in a sample test file silently vanishes from the JUnit report: the base set under-counts and the red gate counts the test as new. Nothing warns, because the report parses and simply holds fewer cases.
proposed_resolution: Either the sample's tests stay class-only (as today, and as the e2e loaders rely on) or the runner converts module-level test functions explicitly. Worth a sentence in the packaging test tiers when the sample grows.
